Portal Update: New Features to Improve Your Ordering Experience

August 2026


We've rolled out several improvements to the PPI Customer Portal this month to make it faster and easier to place and manage your orders. Here's what's new:


1. Shipping Carrier Selection for Heavy Items

We're updating carrier selection in the Portal to help prevent shipping issues on heavier items and keep your orders moving smoothly.


What's Changing

•     FedEx Ground, UPS Ground, and UPS NDA cannot be used for any individual item weighing 140 lbs or more, and are not recommended for shipments of 140 lbs or more, since these carriers have package weight limits.

•     This applies when Collect or 3rd Party Bill To is selected as the delivery method. If a qualifying item is in your order, those carrier options will be grayed out and unavailable to select.

•     Hovering over a grayed-out carrier name will show a message explaining why the option isn't available and what to do instead.


What to Do Instead

If your order is at or above 140 lbs (with no individual item at or above 140 lbs) and you'd like it shipped in multiple packages, select Will Advise as your delivery method and note your request in the Shipping Instructions field.


2. Easier Ship-To Address Management

Finding and managing Ship-To addresses at checkout and in My Account is now faster and simpler.

•     A new search bar lets you quickly find a Ship-To address by name, company, street, city, state, or postal code.

•     Sort your address list by name, city, state, most recently used, or default address.

•     Available in both the checkout Shipping Address step and the My Account address page.

•     The address form now uses a single Name field in place of separate First Name, Last Name, and Company Name fields. Your existing addresses will update automatically to the new format — no re-entry required, and no address information will be lost.


﻿3. Smarter Inventory & Lead Time Visibility

It's now easier to know what's available and when it will ship, right from the product listing page.

•     The old “Check Inventory” label is replaced with a direct availability status on every product: In Stock, Low Stock, or Made to Order.

•     Hover over a product's status to see the exact quantity available and which service center it's stocked at.

•     Hovering over a service center location now also shows expected lead time guidance for that location, by product type and quantity, so you can plan around fulfillment timing before you order.


4. Clearer Service Center Names

Inventory locations will now display using clear City/State naming (for example, “Corning, IA”) instead of internal warehouse codes. These friendly names will appear anywhere inventory locations show up in the Portal, including product availability and order details — no more guessing what a warehouse code stands for.


What You Need to Do

Nothing. All of these updates apply automatically — there's no setup, re-entry, or action required on your part. You'll see the changes the next time you browse products, check out, or visit My Account.


If you have questions about any of these updates, or about availability, lead times, or shipping on a specific order, your PPI representative is always ready to help — or reach out to the Digital Customer Experience team.
